# Vendored dependency: Eigen

- **Version:** 5.0.1
- **Source:** https://gitlab.com/libeigen/eigen/-/archive/5.0.1/eigen-5.0.1.tar.gz
- **Upstream:** https://libeigen.gitlab.io/
- **License:** MPL 2.0 (see `COPYING.MPL2` and `LICENSE`; `COPYING.README` lists
  the licenses of the bundled third-party components).

Only the header-only `Eigen/` directory and license files are vendored. Add
`-Ithird_party/eigen` to the compiler include path to use it.
